messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: service=api-gateway image=api-gateway:v2.9.0 -> v2.10.0. change-window=2024-08-22T20:00Z. staged 5% traffic to apac region.

lina: noticed a brief 5xx uptick in apac at 20:04. small sample but matching deploy time, flagging.

obs-bot: ALERT (apac): route=embed-api 5xx_rate = 0.8% (threshold 0.2%) over 3m. p95 latency unchanged.

rick: I see spikes from a handful of clients hitting large batched requests. autoscaler didn't spin extra pods fast enough. looks like concurrency pressure.

evan: can we throttle batch_size on the canary route? quick patch to config map would cut peak memory.

lina: please pause rollout and pin prod alias back to v2.9.0 for safety. we should annotate release notes and open incident ticket.

maria: pausing now. deploy-bot -> pause-rollout applied. current_traffic=5%. pinned_alias=api-prod -> v2.9.0. :lock:

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by maria. event=hold-1748132000-1.

rick: creating INF-8279 for follow-up (link: https://go/repo/issue/INF-8279). attaching short flame graph and a list of offending client IPs. assigning to eng-runtime.

evan: quick mitigation path: reduce max_batch to 4 on canary and bump replica target temporarily. I can push a config change to the canary receiver and run a 10m soak.

lina: do that on canary only. do not touch prod alias until we confirm SLOs stable for 15m.

rick: command I ran to reproduce the spike: ```ab -n 100 -c 10 https://apac.api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/embeddings -p payload.json -T application/json```

rick: results: 5xxs reproduced at concurrency 8+. detailed logs in INF-8279.

maria: obs-bot, can you take a baseline snapshot and add an annotation: "v2.10.0 canary staged 5% -> paused due to 5xx uptick"?

obs-bot: Snapshot taken id=snap-20240822-2007. Annotation added to SLO dashboard.

lina: decision: hold and pin. mitigation plan: (1) evan to test max_batch=4 + replica bump on canary (2) eng-runtime to inspect autoscaler thresholds (rick) (3) product to update release notes with hold (maria). Reopen only if 5xx < 0.25% and p95 within 5% of baseline for 15m.

evan: applying canary config tweak now. will post quick metrics.

rick: note for release notes: "v2.10.0 canary paused in APAC at 5% due to transient 5xx increase; production pinned to v2.9.0. engineering investigating autoscaler and batch sizing. Follow-up ticket INF-8279."

maria: tagging oncall for overnight watch if this lingers. pinging @eng-oncall.

evan: canary metrics after tweak (2m): 5xx_rate -> 0.18%, p95 -> unchanged. posting graph in INF-8279.

lina: good. keep canary paused and continue soak for 15m. we'll reconvene after the soak window.

deploy-bot: Event updated: hold continues. traffic remains at 5%.

maria: closing thread for now; will reopen if obs-bot fires another alert. :white_check_mark:
